headline: Starting again? Make your first step manageable.
takeaway: Put your trainers by the back door tonight.
caption:
Starting again? Give yourself a clear place to begin.

Put your trainers by the back door tonight and choose a time for a short walk tomorrow. Pick something that fits your day and your ability.

What will your first step be?
